title: Valeria | Minecraft Cinematics
description: A cinematic modpack that is heavily optimized.
body:
# Enter a Cinematic World with Valeria:
Valeria adds releastic footsteps, new rain particles, ambient noises, QoL changes, camera upgrades and so much more.


## **Read if you have a potato PC (Like Me)**
This modpack runs high profile shaders at 30-60 FPS with an additonal 356 chunk load on Distant Horizons, my current GPU is the 1650-Ti Max design, use this to benchmark your specs!
